items.text: GitHub has fully retired GitHub Models, its unified LLM API and playground, with no official explanation; Simon Willison migrated his Actions workflow to OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Luna.
items.text_zh: GitHub 已彻底下线统一大模型 API 与试验场 GitHub Models，官方未作解释；Simon Willison 已把自己的 Actions 工作流迁移到 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6 Luna。

items.text: Simon Willison had GPT-5.6 Sol Pro build SQLite text-history prototypes in 38 minutes, compressing 1,000 document revisions from 20.4 MB to 80.3 KB.
items.text_zh: Simon Willison 让 GPT-5.6 Sol Pro 用 38 分钟做出 SQLite 文本修订历史原型，把 1000 个版本从 20.4 MB 压缩到 80.3 KB。

items.text: Pika fed Seedance 2.5 a music track plus character and location references and got back a full music video, praising the model's choreography.
items.text_zh: Pika 给 Seedance 2.5 输入一段音乐加角色与场景参考图，直接生成了一支完整 MV，并称赞模型编排的舞蹈动作。

items.text: Hedge fund Situational Awareness put another $400 million into chip startup Source Foundry, reaching $500 million total after its assets under management halved to $10 billion.
items.text_zh: 对冲基金 Situational Awareness 再向芯片创业公司 Source Foundry 投入 4 亿美元，累计达 5 亿美元；此前其管理规模已从 200 亿美元腰斩至 100 亿美元。

items.text: A MarkTechPost survey of LLM observability platforms notes 89% of agent teams run observability but only 37.3% do online evaluation, in a $2.69 billion market.
items.text_zh: MarkTechPost 盘点大模型可观测性平台：89% 的 agent 团队已接入可观测性，但仅 37.3% 做在线评测，该市场今年规模为 26.9 亿美元。

items.text: Google is preparing to retire Gems in the Gemini web app by October 20, pushing users to Skills, which currently require a paid subscription and are region-limited.
items.text_zh: 谷歌准备在 10 月 20 日前下线 Gemini 网页版的 Gems，转由 Skills 接替，而 Skills 目前需付费订阅且仅限部分地区使用。

items.text: Databricks says its Genie Code data agent beat three leading coding agents on 400+ real data tasks, with the highest accuracy at roughly half the cost per task.
items.text_zh: Databricks 称其数据智能体 Genie Code 在 400 多个真实数据任务上击败三家主流编程智能体，准确率最高且单任务成本约为对手的一半。

items.text: PixVerse published an AI ad template arguing sports-gear spots need one locked visual system and six connected shots rather than physics-breaking VFX.
items.text_zh: PixVerse 发布 AI 广告模板，主张运动装备广告不需要炫技特效，而应锁定一套统一视觉系统加六个连贯镜头。

items.text: Historian Jill Lepore argues in a new interview that tech firms are usurping state functions, calling it rule by algorithm and misreading of science fiction.
items.text_zh: 历史学家 Jill Lepore 在最新访谈中批评科技公司正在取代国家职能，称其为“算法统治”，并指硅谷把科幻当蓝图而非警世寓言。

items.text: Meshy is taking its Creative Lab to SuperZoo 2026 in Las Vegas, demonstrating turning pet photos into personalized 3D creations for the pet-products industry.
items.text_zh: Meshy 将带着 Creative Lab 亮相拉斯维加斯 SuperZoo 2026，现场演示把宠物照片转成个性化 3D 模型，面向宠物用品行业。

items.text: Scammers are enrolling fake students at US community colleges to collect financial aid, then using AI to complete the coursework and avoid detection.
items.text_zh: 诈骗者在美国社区大学批量注册虚假学生以骗取助学金，再用 AI 完成课程作业规避识别。

items.text: The Verge argues AI writing detectors are producing a new era of distrust, with accusations landing on writers who never used a model.
items.text_zh: The Verge 撰文指出，AI 写作检测器正在制造新一轮的普遍猜疑，不少从未用过模型的写作者反被误判。

items.text: Lovart added Seedance 2.5 to its agent canvas, letting users turn a single photo into a hyper-realistic 30-second vlog from one prompt.
items.text_zh: Lovart 已接入 Seedance 2.5，用户一句提示词即可把一张照片变成 30 秒超写实 vlog。
